material.scopeLabel: Selected operational preparations, variant and control contexts, workup, storage and analytical preparations from all 9 main and 16 SI pages. Reported typical methods are distinct from incompletely specified plotted variants. InP clusters, conversion intermediates and InP/ZnSeS products are not conflated. Unknown zinc charges, shell feed allocation, batch identities and conflicting source labels remain explicit. This is source evidence, not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative review.
